public_archive_title: Reports describe deaths from Israeli fire in eastern Deir al-Balah
public_archive_summary: Reuters reported that local medics said Israeli fire killed two people in separate incidents in eastern Deir al-Balah on November 17, including a six-year-old boy. Anadolu separately cited Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital reporting a 21-year-old man killed east of the city. Al Jazeera’s Arabic report also described the deaths of a man aged 21 and a boy aged 6 in al-Jafarawi. These overlapping accounts are not added together; the outlets’ wider Gaza totals cover different reported incidents. Reuters said Israeli military comment was not immediately available.
